Money flow  - createEscrow pulls the SUM of all milestone amounts from msg.sender (the client) with    transferFrom. The client then approves and releases, or disputes.  - Auto-release: once block.timestamp >= deliveredAt + autoReleaseDays * 1 days, ANYONE may call    releaseMilestone for a Delivered milestone.
